strings.name: Rodolphe Saadé
strings.role: CMA CGM chair and chief executive
strings.summary: Saadé rose through shipping-line operations at the group founded by his father, becoming CEO and then chair in 2017. Through NOL, CEVA and other transactions, he connected maritime, port, land and air logistics and expanded into media. Shipping cycles, geopolitical disruption and decarbonization investment shape the business.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Leads CMA CGM’s expansion in shipping, ports and integrated logistics, contributing to global supply-chain services.

strings.facts.f2.label: Education

strings.highlights.h2.text: Adds media alongside logistics and air cargo, broadening the group.
